delivers_pr.instructions: Does the operator want the work delivered as a pull request that ends up reviewable (open a PR, push to the PR, ship this)?

needs_verification.instructions: Does the goal change code that must be verified (tests, build, lint) before it can be considered done?

asks_for_review.instructions: Does the operator expect an independent review, or CI checks going green, before they look at the work?

request_shape.instructions: How closely does the goal match 'build this and get it into a reviewable PR'?
